body: Presumably it's not, but only because RenderingDevice itself declares uniform set creation as a thread safe method, something that may very well go away in the future. I'd keep it.
There seems to be no mechanism for growing the heap once it's been allocated. Is this the reason for the crash?

As with my comment below and above, this crash happens on the master branch aswell. 
The heap is not growable, DescriptorHeaps can not be resized, I just allocate a new one instead.
For future reference, this same issue was fixed by https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/113000

Good to know.  I was looking at the code in the 4.5 branch and saw it wasn't fix there (and the code removed in 4.6) and thought it never was.

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/4.5/drivers/d3d12/rendering_device_driver_d3d12.cpp#L491
